views.label: Scalar $K$
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of the scalar wave over the plane of $\theta$ and $t$ ($x=y=0$).
views.input: $P=\tfrac12J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\Phi=\tfrac7{20}J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $\lambda=\tfrac{99}{200}B$, with $B=\tfrac12t^2(J_0^2+J_1^2)-tJ_0J_1\cos^2\theta$ and $J_0,J_1$ the Bessel functions of the first kind at $t$.
views.clip: Signed logarithmic colour scale, linear near zero.

views.label: Electromagnetic $K$
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of the electromagnetic wave over the plane of $\theta$ and $t$ ($x=y=0$).
views.input: $U=\tfrac12\ln t+\tfrac25J_0(t)\cos\theta$, $P=2\ln\cosh U+\ln t$, $\chi=\tanh U$, $\lambda=4(\bar\lambda+\ln\cosh U)+\ln t$, with $\bar\lambda=\tfrac14\ln t+\tfrac25J_0(t)\cos\theta+\tfrac4{25}B$ and $B=\tfrac12t^2(J_0^2+J_1^2)-tJ_0J_1\cos^2\theta$; $J_0,J_1$ are the Bessel functions of the first kind at $t$.
views.clip: Signed logarithmic colour scale, linear near zero.
